narrative:
Headcount planning covers 89,900 FTEs. Total people cost of USD 16.4B is 25.9% of revenue.

Capacity pressure follows volume: Respiratory & Immunology is ahead of plan and needs the earliest staffing decision.

signals.title: Q3 hard close locked at WD+5, two days faster than Q2. US gross-to-net accruals are still the last item to lock
signals.source: SDP Group Close Control Tower — 8 close feeds, September 2026 quarter-end
signals.excerpt: The September quarter-end close locked at WD+5 against WD+7 in Q2. 91.4% of balance-sheet reconciliations were auto-certified, and USD 486M was still unreconciled at WD+3. 61% of that (USD 297M) sits in US gross-to-net accruals, driven by the Medicare Part D redesign and 340B contract-pharmacy claims.
